mike_ops: @channel Heads-up: Planned maintenance for production Redis cluster (primary region). Window: 2026-02-15 22:00 - 23:00 UTC (1h). Purpose: minor version upgrade + config tuning. Expected impact: no user-facing downtime, but we expect a short latency spike (~2-5m) during the failover test. We will throttle background sync jobs and have a rollback plan. Filing status page + support advisory now. Please shout if this conflicts with any customer launches. :calendar:

anya_sre: Thanks Mike. I reviewed the runbook — will run failover in canary shard first, then primary. Mitigations: prefix KV-cache warmup, emergency read-only fallback to replica, and immediate rollback script ready. I’ll be on call for the window and will trigger the incident channel if we see >5% 5xxs.

product-comm: Can you drop a suggested status-page entry + customer email? I’ll get legal/CS eyes if needed. Also, we should plan an in-app banner placed 1hr before the window.

mike_ops: Draft status page copy below (please review). Posting to status page after approvals.

```
Summary: We will perform a minor upgrade and configuration tuning on the Redis cluster in our primary region. During the maintenance window, short latency increases (2-5 minutes) may occur while replicas are promoted. No downtime expected.

Start: 2026-02-15 22:00 UTC
End: 2026-02-15 23:00 UTC
Impact: Short latency spikes for a subset of requests; background jobs will be throttled.

Action: Our engineers will perform an orchestrated failover and monitor traffic. If issues arise, we will roll back to the previous version.

Updates: We will post progress updates here and on status.redwood.ai.
```

Please call out anything missing.

Dave_support: Need a 24h notice to our Enterprise customers (legal SLA). Also request primary escalation contacts for the maintenance window. I can push an advisory once copy is final.

mike_ops: Copy updated. Also note: due to a scheduling conflict raised by a large customer, we need to shift the event by +3 hours. New window: 2026-02-16 01:00 - 02:00 UTC. Reason: avoids overlap with customer cron job in their TZ. Apologies for the churn — final unless someone objects in the next 30m.

product-comm: Fine by us. Here's the customer-facing advisory/email and in-app banner draft — please review and approve.

```
Subject: Upcoming maintenance: brief Redis performance maintenance (Feb 16, 01:00 UTC)

Hello,

We will be performing a brief maintenance on our Redis cache cluster on Feb 16, 01:00 - 02:00 UTC. During this time you may experience short latency spikes for a small percentage of requests (typically under 5 minutes). No data loss or downtime is expected. Background job scheduling may be delayed.

What we’re doing: minor version upgrade and configuration tuning to improve stability.

If you have concerns or want this maintenance moved for your org, please reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai with your account ID.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations

In-app banner (short): "Planned maintenance: Redis cluster — Feb 16, 01:00–02:00 UTC. Short latency spikes possible."
```

oncall-jen: I’ll take point for the window. Paging plan: if >5% 5xx or >150ms p95 for 10 minutes, page oncall-jen -> anya_sre -> mike_ops escalation. Hand-off notes: I’ll be on-call from 00:45 - 03:00 UTC to cover pre-check and immediate remediation.

statusbot: Scheduled maintenance created on status.redwood.ai (ID: MAINT-20260216-01). Reminder set: 24h and 1h before window.

mike_ops: Thanks everyone — final confirmation: window moved to 2026-02-16 01:00 - 02:00 UTC. I’ll post the customer email at t-24h and the in-app banner t-1h.

---  (during/after window timeline) ---

statusbot: MAINT-20260216-01: In progress. Update: failover executed on canary shard at 01:12 UTC, primary promotion at 01:18 UTC. Observed a 3m latency spike during promotion. No increase in 5xxs above alert threshold.

anya_sre: Completed post-checks. Cache warmup completed by 01:24 UTC. Verified p95 back to baseline within 4 minutes. No rollback required.

mike_ops: Maintenance completed at 01:30 UTC. Summary: upgrade succeeded; observed expected short latency spike during failover (3 minutes). No customer-facing incidents. Postmortem stub created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/MAINT-20260216-01 (please add notes if you ran any manual steps).

dave_support: Thanks — I’ll send the follow-up notification to affected customers and close the advisory.

product-comm: Posting completion update to status page and clearing in-app banner. Good job team. :tada:

infra-bot: Auto-note — maintenance MAINT-20260216-01 closed. Metrics snapshot attached to ticket.
